fichas.title: Construction Costs
fichas.summary: Explains how influence over construction costs declines as design and construction progress while expenditure rises, and outlines DIN 276 cost groups and the cost estimate, cost calculation, cost forecast, and final cost statement required during project delivery. Cost determinations should use a consistent structure and document the cost situation, building description, VAT, date, and relevant design work.
uses: Documenting cost determinations during design and construction
